      "evidence": "Reproduction in a throwaway clone at the reviewed commit.       "title": "Class: incomplete-item. Where: metasystem/cmd/metasystem/test_impact.go. The goal's intent is that the unit check and the independent read run the repository-walking audits the lane runs, so that a red the lane will find is found at the seat. This unit covers only two kinds: audits in the cmd/metasystem package (through proof.audits) and audits inside the three always-standard groups. Into those groups it moved just the two audit files tied to finding 459. Other repository-walking audits that the lane's full proof runs stay in their own packages. They are selected only when the impact adapter happens to pick their package, which it does not do for a text or comment change elsewhere. So the defect class behind finding 459 (the-steward-sees returned for an audit neither its build nor its read ran) recurs for those audits, and nothing stops a new repository-walking audit from being added outside internal/testenv. Change: make the selection follow the class rather than two hand-moved files. Either move or declare every repository-walking audit (for example TestTheEvidenceRootKeyIsSpelledOnlyByItsOwner, TestTheOldBatchOwnerIsGone, the internal/layering R9 audits and TestDegradedFormsHaveOneSource) into an always-standard audit group that the new selection already picks up, or add a check that refuses a test walking the module root outside such a group. Alternatively, narrow the goal's stated scope to finding 459 and record the rest as a split follow-up goal."
